extracted_concepts.name: Multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand multiplication as equal groups and use it within 100.

extracted_concepts.name: Division
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand division as sharing equally and use it within 100.

extracted_concepts.name: Addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Combine quantities and solve problems using addition.

extracted_concepts.name: Subtraction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find differences and solve problems using subtraction.

extracted_concepts.name: Equal groups
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Multiplication is understood as equal groups.

extracted_concepts.name: Sharing equally
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Division is understood as sharing equally.

extracted_concepts.name: Word problems
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solve one-step, two-step, and multistep problems in context.

extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic patterns
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Identify arithmetic patterns such as multiples of 5.

extracted_concepts.name: Multiples
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers such as multiples of 5 or multiples of a given one-digit number.

extracted_concepts.name: Place value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use place value to round, add, and understand multi-digit numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Multi-digit place value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Generalize place value understanding for multi-digit whole numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Rounding whole numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Round whole numbers to the nearest 10 or 100.

extracted_concepts.name: Multi-digit addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fluently add within 1000 using place value understanding.

extracted_concepts.name: Multiplication by multiples of 10
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Multiply one-digit whole numbers by multiples of 10.

extracted_concepts.name: Standard algorithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fluently add, subtract, or multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.

extracted_concepts.name: Fraction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A fraction a/b is a parts of size 1/b.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit fraction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A fraction 1/b is one part of a whole partitioned into b equal parts.

extracted_concepts.name: Fractions on a number line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Represent fractions on a number line.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent fractions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Explain equivalence of fractions, such as 1/2 = 2/4.

extracted_concepts.name: Comparing fractions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Compare fractions with same or different numerators and denominators.

extracted_concepts.name: Adding fractions with like denominators
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Add fractions with like denominators.

extracted_concepts.name: Adding fractions with unlike denominators
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators.

extracted_concepts.name: Multiplying fraction by whole number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Multiply a fraction by a whole number.

extracted_concepts.name: Fraction as division
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Interpret a fraction as division of numerator by denominator.

extracted_concepts.name: Dividing unit fractions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimal notation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understand decimal notation for fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimal fractions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Compare decimal fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relate area to multiplication and addition.

extracted_concepts.name: Area additivity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Recognize area as additive.

extracted_concepts.name: Partitioning shapes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Partition shapes into parts with equal areas.

extracted_concepts.name: Line plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Make a line plot to display data measured in fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Recognize volume as an attribute of three-dimensional figures.
